title: Separation of variables for coupled radiative perturbations of Kerr-Newman-de Sitter black holes
summary: We extend Hintz's separation of variables for radiative gravitational and electromagnetic perturbations from Kerr-Newman to Kerr-Newman-de Sitter black holes. On subextremal backgrounds with nonzero rotation and charge, an explicit algebraic matrix transformation yields coupled two-component radial and angular ordinary differential systems linked by a common separation constant. The transformation is independent of the frequency and azimuthal number and applies to both signs of spin weight. For real frequencies, we establish a complete angular mode decomposition.
